tasks.title: Implement input validation module
tasks.description: Create a validation module to verify inputs for all task operations. Validate required fields (title, status values), data types, string lengths, and format constraints. Prevent invalid data from reaching the Notion API.
acceptance_criteria: Validation functions for title, status, notes, and pageId
Clear error messages for validation failures
Prevent empty or null required fields

tasks.title: Implement structured logging system
tasks.description: Set up a logging framework with multiple log levels (debug, info, warn, error). Include timestamps, operation context, and structured data. Log all API calls and their outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Logger module with configurable log levels

tasks.title: Refactor project structure
tasks.description: Reorganize codebase into a modular structure with separate directories for source code, configuration, and utilities. Move existing functions into appropriate modules.

tasks.title: Enhance error handling for existing functions
tasks.description: Improve error handling in createTask and updateTask functions. Add retry logic for transient failures, validate responses, and provide detailed error context.
acceptance_criteria: Implement retry mechanism with exponential backoff
Use logging system for error tracking

tasks.title: Implement task retrieval functionality
tasks.description: Add function to retrieve a single task by ID from the Notion database. Include proper error handling for non-existent tasks and API failures.

tasks.title: Implement task listing and filtering
tasks.description: Create function to list all tasks with optional filtering by status, assignee, and date ranges. Support pagination for large result sets.
acceptance_criteria: Return array of formatted task objects

tasks.title: Implement task deletion functionality
tasks.description: Add function to delete (archive) tasks from the Notion database. Include confirmation and proper error handling.

tasks.title: Implement API rate limiting
tasks.description: Add rate limiting mechanism to respect Notion API rate limits (3 requests per second). Implement request queuing and throttling.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiter module with configurable limits
Monitor and log rate limit status

tasks.title: Add configuration management
tasks.description: Enhance configuration system with validation, defaults, and support for multiple environments. Validate required environment variables on startup.
acceptance_criteria: Clear error messages for missing configs

tasks.title: Create unit tests for core functions
tasks.description: Implement unit tests for validation, task creation, updating, retrieval, and deletion functions. Mock Notion API calls. Achieve >80% code coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Test suite using Jest or Mocha
Unit tests for all public functions

tasks.title: Create integration tests
tasks.description: Implement integration tests that verify end-to-end functionality with actual or mocked Notion API. Test complete workflows like create-update-delete task lifecycle.

tasks.title: Add task search functionality
tasks.description: Implement search capability to find tasks by keywords in title or notes. Support case-insensitive search and multiple search terms.

tasks.title: Create API documentation
tasks.description: Document all public functions, parameters, return values, and error conditions. Include usage examples and setup instructions.
acceptance_criteria: JSDoc comments for all public functions
README with setup and usage examples

tasks.title: Add batch operations support
tasks.description: Implement batch create, update, and delete operations to handle multiple tasks efficiently. Use Notion's batch API capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Respect rate limits during batch operations

tasks.title: Create example usage scripts
tasks.description: Develop example scripts demonstrating common use cases: creating tasks, updating status, querying tasks, and complete workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Example script for task creation workflow
Example script for task status updates
Example script for querying and filtering
